svg.text: 1. Cabinet body: 2 mm steel sheet, welded construction.
2. Finish: electrostatic outdoor powder coat, RAL 7035 light grey.
3. Overall envelope 1728 x 814 x 462 mm (H x W x D), canopy 960 x 608.
5. Front door hinged on right, left-hand handle; side door on left face.
7. Dimensions in millimetres. Do not scale from print.
